shipping.deadlines_1: Mainland Spain: 7 to 15 business days from order confirmation.
shipping.deadlines_3: Canary Islands, Ceuta and Melilla: 12 to 25 business days, possibly subject to customs clearance.
shipping.deadlines_4: Rest of the European Union: 10 to 20 business days.
shipping.deadlines_5: Rest of the world: 15 to 30 business days, possibly subject to customs clearance depending on the destination country.
shipping.deadlines_6: Order preparation: 1-2 business days before the package ships.
shipping.why_1: We work with an international supplier instead of keeping our own warehouse in Spain.
shipping.why_2: That makes delivery longer, but it's what lets us sell for €39.90 a shaper that would cost quite a bit more in a physical store.
shipping.why_3: We'd rather tell you clearly before you buy than have you be surprised afterward.
shipping.why_4: If you need the shaper for a specific date, order it at least three weeks ahead (more if your country is outside the European Union).
shipping.costs_1: Free shipping to any country in the world, with no minimum purchase.
shipping.costs_2: Delivery times vary by destination: see the section above.
shipping.tracking_1: You'll receive a confirmation email as soon as you place your order.
shipping.tracking_2: When the package ships, you'll get another email with the tracking number and a link to see where it is.
shipping.tracking_3: If 4 business days pass and you haven't received a tracking number, write to us.
shipping.tracking_4: Tracking can take 2-3 days to show movement: that's normal for international shipments.
shipping.issues_1: Package damaged on arrival: don't refuse it. Photograph it and write to us within the first 24 hours.
shipping.issues_2: If you pass the maximum stated timeframe without receiving your order, write to us with your order number and we’ll trace it or refund you.
shipping.issues_3: Wrong address: let us know the same day you order. Once it leaves the warehouse we can no longer change it.
shipping.issues_4: Customs: shipments to the Canary Islands, Ceuta, Melilla and countries outside the European Union may be subject to customs or import fees payable by the recipient, according to each country’s regulations.
shipping.contact_text: For any question about your shipment, email
shipping.contact_text_end: including your order number. We reply within 24 hours on business days.

returns.callout_1: 30 days. Free returns. No questions asked.
returns.callout_2: Nuvel isn't for you if it doesn't do exactly what it promises. Period.
returns.deadline_1: You have 30 calendar days from the date you receive your order to start a return.
returns.deadline_2: After that period, we can't accept returns unless the product is defective.
returns.condition_1: The item must be unused, with the original tags attached and in its original packaging.
returns.condition_2: For hygiene reasons, we don't accept returns of used or washed items: please try it on over underwear.
returns.step_1: Step 1: Email hola@nuvelshape.store with your order number and reason for the return (optional).
returns.step_2: We'll send you a prepaid return label within 24 hours (business days).
returns.step_3: Drop the package off at any carrier collection point.
returns.step_4: As soon as we receive the item, we process the refund within 3-5 business days.
returns.size_change_1: If you ordered the wrong size, the process is identical to a return: email hola@nuvelshape.store.
returns.size_change_2: The exchange is free on your first order: we want you to get the size right.
returns.size_change_3: We arrange shipping of the new item as soon as we receive the original.
returns.defective_1: If you receive a damaged or defective item, write to us within the first 48 hours with photos.
returns.defective_2: We'll replace it at no cost, and in most cases you won't need to return the damaged item.
returns.refunds_1: The refund is issued to the same payment method used for the order.
returns.refunds_2: Timeframe: 3-5 business days from when we receive the item.
returns.refunds_3: There may be an additional 2-3 day delay depending on your bank or financial institution.

privacy.controller_text: Nuvel is an online store run from Venezuela that sells to customers in any country in the world. When the buyer resides in the European Union, we process their data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR, EU Regulation 2016/679), even though we are not established in the Union. For buyers from other countries, we apply these same data protection standards as a minimum.
privacy.platform_text: the store runs on Shopify, which acts as the data processor.
privacy.s1_text: Nuvel (hereinafter, "the company"). Contact for privacy matters: hola@nuvelshape.store.
privacy.s2_text: We collect the data you provide when placing an order (first and last name, delivery address, email address and phone number), as well as anonymous browsing data needed for the store to function (technical cookies).
privacy.s3_text: The data is used exclusively to: (a) process and manage your order; (b) communications related to that order (confirmation, tracking, issues); (c) handle inquiries and return or exchange requests.
privacy.s4_text: Processing is based on the performance of the sales contract (GDPR, art. 6.1.b). For marketing communications, the basis is explicit consent (art. 6.1.a).
privacy.s5_text: Order data is kept for the legally required period (5 years for tax purposes). Once that period ends, the data is securely deleted.
privacy.s6_text: We don't sell or share your data with third parties for commercial purposes. We only share it with the logistics provider needed to deliver your order and with the payment platform to process the transaction, both bound by confidentiality agreements.
privacy.s7_text: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict or object to the processing of your data, as well as to data portability. To exercise these rights, email hola@nuvelshape.store identifying yourself as a customer and specifying the right you wish to exercise. We will respond within a maximum of 30 days.
privacy.s8_text: We only use technical cookies necessary for the store to function (cart session, preferences). We don't use third-party tracking or advertising cookies without your consent.
privacy.s9_text: We reserve the right to update this policy. Significant changes will be communicated by email or through a visible notice in the store.

faq.q_rolls: Does it roll up when walking or sitting?
faq.a_rolls: No. That's exactly why Nuvel exists. The girdle has a silicone band on the inner top edge that anchors it to your skin and keeps it in place even when you sit, bend, climb stairs or dance at a wedding. We tested different patterns and band heights for months until we found the combination that works on real bodies, not mannequins.
faq.q_size: How do I choose the right size?
faq.a_size: We use a guide based on your waist and hip measurements, not your usual clothing size (which varies a lot by brand). On the product page you'll find the full chart in centimeters. If you're between two sizes, choose the larger one: Nuvel compresses without squeezing, so it never rides up.
faq.q_visible: Does it show under dresses and tight pants?
faq.a_visible: No. The edges are laser-cut, with no raised seam and no fabric step. They're so thin they disappear under silk, crepe or any fitted fabric. It was the first requirement of the pattern: that a woman could put on a fitted dress without having to check it doesn't show before heading out.
faq.q_bathroom: Can I use the bathroom without taking it off?
faq.a_bathroom: The girdle has an opening where it's needed, designed so you can use the bathroom without undressing and putting it back on. That said, we always recommend checking it's sitting right when you're done.
faq.q_washing: How many times can I wash it?
faq.a_washing: No limit. The fabric is designed to keep its structure and compression after many washes. We recommend hand washing or a delicate cycle at 30°C, no spin, and air drying. Following this, the girdle keeps its shape.
faq.q_curvy: Does it work if I have love handles?
faq.a_curvy: Yes. We use progressive compression: layered, from softer to firmer, instead of squeezing everything equally and creating the classic bulge at the back and hips. The result is a smooth finish, not a roll marked at the fabric’s edge.
faq.q_heat: Is it too warm? Does it breathe?
faq.a_heat: The microfiber breathes and doesn't trap heat like girdles made from cheap synthetic fabrics. You can wear it in summer, even at 30°C at a wedding, without ending up drenched. That said, it's still a compression garment, not a dress.
faq.q_itchy: Does it itch? Can I wear it all day?
faq.a_itchy: The microfiber we use is certified and has no raised seams or stiff fabrics that chafe the skin. Designed for eight hours of continuous wear. The structure keeps its shape after dozens of washes.
faq.q_return: What if I'm not convinced? Can I return it?
faq.a_return: Yes. You have 30 days from receiving your order to return it, no explanation needed. Email us at hola@nuvelshape.store and we’ll arrange a home pickup, at no cost to you. Buying underwear online requires trust, and that trust has to go both ways.
faq.more_questions: Can't find what you're looking for?

about.p1: Nuvel was born out of the same old frustration: the shaper that rolls up by mid-afternoon, the one that itches, the one that shows under your dress on exactly the day you need it most. Before selling a single garment, we tried the fast-fashion ones ourselves and wrote down everything that failed, so we wouldn’t repeat it.
about.p2: We bought several, the cheap ones and the expensive ones, and wore them for entire days: to work, to dinner, to a wedding. We noted what time each one rolled up, where it showed, and how long it lasted before bothering us. With that list in hand, we looked for a manufacturer that could meet every point, and we didn’t launch anything until a garment passed that same full-day test.
about.quote: We weren't looking for a miracle shaper. We were looking for one that did what it promised: doesn't roll up, doesn't show, and lasts a full day worn.
about.p3: That's where our product decisions come from: laser-cut edges so they don't show under clothes, progressive compression instead of squeezing everything equally, an inner band so it doesn't ride up, and a size chart in centimeters so you know exactly which one to order.
about.p4: Today we sell directly, with no store in between, and we answer every WhatsApp message ourselves. No magic promises: if a garment hadn’t convinced us in person, we wouldn’t launch it.
about.closing_line: The silhouette you want. Without anyone knowing.
about.closing_sub: 30-day trial · Free worldwide shipping in 7-15 days
